notes.title: We’re announcing a new video game: Dark Mass, an underwater horror adventure.
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1879940/Dark_Mass/

We're thrilled to announce our brand new game: Dark Mass, an immersive underwater horror adventure!

In Dark Mass, players take on the role of Alice, a deep-sea explorer who, alongside her brother Reed, discovers the wreckage of an ancient ship. However, beneath this wreck lies something far more sinister—a manor lost to time, eerily untouched despite centuries hidden in the abyss.

As Alice ventures into the submerged manor, she quickly realizes she's not alone. Something lurks in the shadows, watching her every move. Trapped within the decaying halls, Alice must unravel chilling mysteries, solve dark ritualistic puzzles, and confront the horrifying truths that tie her fate to this forsaken place.

[previewyoutube=j2sv9NAia24;full][/previewyoutube]

Played entirely from a first-person perspective, Dark Mass embraces the thrilling atmosphere of classic horror titles while introducing a unique underwater twist. The aquatic setting fundamentally transforms gameplay, allowing exploration across various heights, dimensions, and perspectives, masterfully utilizing the fear of deep waters (thalassophobia) to create a deeply intense and innovative horror experience.

With fully voiced dialogue, realistic underwater physics, and an immersive, haunting narrative, Dark Mass promises a terrifying journey into the unknown, where each decision could mean the difference between survival and doom.

Wishlist Dark Mass now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1879940/Dark_Mass/

[h1]Insomnis comes to terrify Xbox and Epic Games gamers![/h1]

[b]Insomnis [/b]has been making gamers around the world's hair stand on end for some time now. Translated into 15 languages, the horror video game developed by [url=https://twitter.com/Path_Games]Path Games[/url] has garnered critical and sales success among PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and PC users. Users of [url=https://www.xbox.com/es-es/games/store/insomnis/9mxtx27l72hj]Xbox[/url] and [url=https://store.epicgames.com/es-ES/p/insomnis-2c51e7]Epic Games[/url] are in luck because [b]Insomnis is now available on [url=https://www.xbox.com/es-es/games/store/insomnis/9mxtx27l72hj]Xbox[/url] in digital format[/b] from [b]Meridiem Games[/b], and will also be available on [b][url=https://store.epicgames.com/es-ES/p/insomnis-2c51e7]Epic Games[/url][/b].

[previewyoutube=CAWWW-ou4PA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Insomnis is a horror video game based on puzzle solving[/b], set in a changing, maddening scenario. It will lead you to get into the skin of [b]Jon Castevet[/b], a man who thinks he is lucky because he has just inherited a large mansion. What Jon ignores is that the old Castevet's house hides a [b]endless number of secrets[/b], which will throw him into a spiral of horror. An atmospheric horror genre story that will not leave you indifferent.
 
Throughout the plot the player will have to explore a mansion, like someone immersed in a nightmare, and will become familiar with a very fluid gameplay, a [b]progressive learning[/b] that even makes tutorials unnecessary, while learning to use his [b]wits to solve all the riddles[/b], analog and digital, connected to each other... in case he does not lose his sanity.

[b]Featured content: [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Atmospheric Horror:[/b] As you enter the Castevet's abode, the scenery will change and your worst nightmares will come to life. Escape from your past before it's too late!
[*] [b]Analog and digital puzzles:[/b] Solve numerous types of convoluted, interconnected puzzles as you struggle to maintain your sanity.
[*] [b]Story focused on exploration:[/b] Immerse yourself in a morally ambiguous narrative, where nothing is as it seems. Dark secrets await you... Explore your grandfather's abandoned abode in search of answers!
[*] [b]Multiple endings:[/b] Decide with caution, your choices will decide the fate of the characters.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000700/Insomnis/?l=spanish
